candidates.description: This vector activates strongly on Hindi text segments and Devanagari script fragments.
This feature vector represents variations of the Devanagari consonant 'क' (ka) combined with various vowel signs and viramas, alongside its romanized equivalent 'K'.
This feature vector represents common suffixes, root letters, or sub-word tokens frequently occurring in Hindi and South Asian script contexts.
This vector represents common suffixes and endings of verbs in the Marathi language.

This feature vector activates strongly for tokens containing the Devanagari consonant 'फ' (pha) and its corresponding vowel-sign combinations, alongside visually or phonetically similar characters like the Greek letter phi.
This feature vector activates on various punctuation marks, particularly commas combined with Hindi vowel matras.
This vector is related to Hindi consonant clusters and word fragments containing retroflex and dental plosives.
This vector represents Hindi script characters, vowel signs, and phonetic elements.
This vector represents vowel signs and matras from the Devanagari script used in Indian languages.
This feature vector represents characters, roots, and common morphophonemic components specific to the Hindi writing system and Devanagari script.
